settingsMenu.reduceMotionHint: Turns off shake, confetti and pulsing

pace.relaxedDesc: Take your time. Points count 20% less.
pace.blitzDesc: Everything you land is worth 40% more.
pace.title: Set the pace

cookieConsent.message: AtlasMaster stores your name, scores and settings on your own device. Accept, and the game also sends your results to the global leaderboard.
cookieConsent.statusAccepted: The game remembers you on this device, and your results reach the global leaderboard.
cookieConsent.statusDeclined: The game stores nothing and sends nothing. Your name, scores and choices disappear when you close the tab.
cookieConsent.statusUndecided: You haven't chosen yet. The game stores and sends nothing until you do.
cookieConsent.clearConfirm: This deletes your name, leaderboard, level and settings. It can't be undone.
